blurb: Hall of the Above is a community event venue located in the iconic Sonoma County National Bank, built in 1925. As the gateway to downtown Petaluma, it anchors the historic district and takes Pride of Place as a building loved by generations of Petalumans. It seems like everyone has a story about the building.
